name: patsnap
description: Search global patents and scientific literature through Patsnap's hosted MCP server (connect.patsnap.com), with a patsnap-search workflow skill bundled. Needs PATSNAP_API_KEY from the Patsnap Open Platform.

api_key.label: Patsnap API key
